description: This file contains utility Sass functions and mixins for evaluating source code, color manipulations, and theme color retrieval, specifically for Bootstrap-related design system functionality.

methods.name: _assert-ascending
methods.description: Mixin to validate that a Sass map (like grid breakpoints) is in ascending order.

methods.name: _assert-starts-at-zero
methods.description: Mixin to ensure that the first breakpoint starts at zero.

methods.name: str-replace
methods.description: Function to replace substrings within a string.

methods.name: color-yiq
methods.description: Function to determine whether a color is light or dark based on YIQ contrast method.

methods.name: color
methods.description: Function to retrieve a color from the $colors map.

methods.name: theme-color
methods.description: Function to retrieve a theme color from the $theme-colors map.

methods.name: gray
methods.description: Function to retrieve a gray shade from the $grays map.

methods.name: theme-color-level
methods.description: Function to get a shade of a theme color based on a specified level.
